name: Low Oxygen Affinity Gamma Chain Hemoglobin Disease
aliases: Hemoglobin Gamma Chain Low Oxygen Affinity Variant
Hb Gamma Low Oxygen Affinity Disorder

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Low Oxygen Affinity Hemoglobinopathy Diagnostic Criteria

criteria.description: Identification of pathogenic mutation in the gamma globin gene (HBG1 or HBG2) associated with low oxygen affinity
Demonstration of decreased oxygen affinity by hemoglobin oxygen dissociation curve analysis (left-shifted P50)
Presence of mild erythrocytosis or compensatory polycythemia without other causes

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Genetic confirmation of gamma chain mutation plus demonstration of decreased oxygen affinity on hemoglobin studies
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires exclusion of other hemoglobinopathies and secondary causes of altered oxygen affinity.

searchTerms: persistent mild excess red blood cells
chronic slight increase in red blood cells

pathognomonic.symptomName: Reduced hemoglobin oxygen affinity demonstrated by oxygen dissociation curve

searchTerms: high red blood cell count without symptoms
mild shortness of breath with activity
enlarged spleen from blood cell production
spleen swelling due to extra blood cell formation
spleen enlargement caused by blood cell growth outside marrow

rare.symptomName: Transient ischemic attacks due to hyperviscosity
searchTerms: transient ischemic attacks due to hyperviscosity
temporary brain ischemia from blood thickening
blood clots related to high red cells
clotting due to increased blood cells
severe low oxygen episodes needing treatment

laboratory: Left-shifted oxygen dissociation curve with decreased P50
imaging: Possible mild splenomegaly on abdominal ultrasound
other: Normal erythropoietin levels or mildly elevated
Absence of other hemoglobin variants on electrophoresis

distinguishingFeatures: Elevated red cell mass with splenomegaly

redFlags: Sudden onset neurological deficits suggestive of stroke
Severe hypoxic episodes unresponsive to oxygen therapy
Signs of thrombotic complications such as deep vein thrombosis or pulmonary embolism
